versions.content: Configuration of DTCs Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of DTCs. Rationale: The diagnostic stack foresees the existence of entities called diagnostic trouble codes (DTC) that, from a simplified point of view, represent reportable incidents towards a diagnostic tester. In reality, a DTC has more complex features that need to be supported by the diagnostic extract as well. Use Case: The user wants too define a unique identifier that represents a given fault situation, which in turn can be reported to a diagnostic tester. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information can be found in the specification of the AUTOSAR Diagnostic Event Manager [4].
